technical_notes: Symptoms: median latency ~220-320ms from us-east, median ~420-650ms from eu-west for short prompts (<=150 tokens). Tail p95/p99 spikes seen in eu-west: 800-1200ms on 512-token workloads. Streaming chunk drop observed in transcript ff-20260302-aurorabyte-initcall. Probable causes: region routing to fallback model variant under load, large prompt windows w/o prefix caching, client-side timeout set to 2s causing premature aborts/consumer perceived slowness. Immediate recommended changes: 1) Encourage EU users to call eu-west endpoint explicitly (region pinned); 2) Increase client timeout to 10s for initial tests and add retry with jitter for idempotent calls; 3) Trim system+context prompts: move rarely used context to external embeddings or KV cache; 4) Use shorter sampling length + streaming to reduce first-token latency; 5) Run a 24h stress run with their test script (we will provide per-route logging).
